title.narrative: Global Gateway Support Mechanism

description.narrative: The overall objective (impact) is to facilitate that EU policy on quality infrastructure and connectivity is adequately embedded under a harmonized approach at the country and regional level, providing technical support to identify priority areas of investment with partner countries and other stakeholders. It will focus in particular on the transport sector in core topics not covered elsewhere, with an emphasis on the cross-sectoral ones.
